title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal
description: CrowdStrike announced its agreement to acquire Zscaler in a $43.9 billion all-stock transaction, combining endpoint security and cloud-delivered zero-trust access capabilities. The deal aims to create a larger cybersecurity platform with over $10 billion in annual recurring revenue, enhancing network security offerings. Both companies have existing integrations and shared customers, and the acquisition is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike’s fiscal 2028. This is a business transaction and does not represent a security vulnerability or threat.
